tierExplainer.summary: What's the difference between Peers and Coaches?
tierExplainer.peerBody: Anyone with real experience can sign up. Ideal if you just want to chat with someone in your industry or an interesting background and hear first-hand experience.
tierExplainer.peerReqs: Verification: identity, education & work experience review
tierExplainer.mentorBody: For those seeking specific help — structured career planning, guidance and in-depth coaching. Coach cards carry a crown badge.
tierExplainer.mentorReqs: Review: identity, education and work history + supporting materials

disclaimer.title: Platform note
disclaimer.body: The platform reviews coaches' identity, education and work history, but this is not a guarantee of professional ability. Coaches share experience only; this is not psychological counseling, psychotherapy, legal or medical advice. If you are in a mental-health crisis, call the national psychological assistance hotline 12356.
